items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Anyway, May! Well Young asked for a raise. I said, 'You got to be out of your mind, man. How am I going to pay you a raise then we -- I'm only getting four and you're getting two... So, he left and went back to Chicago. The band started to sort of peter out... I'm the band leader.

ctx.x: You have upset said a lot of those cats, I remember when you came in there. I was there.
I know. Dave Young played the good -- good tenor saxophone.
